title: 5.3.2.9 Access Control Metadata Group - ACE (Object Table)

content.text:
The ACE table SHALL have one row for each access control element that MAY be referenced in the
AccessControl table's ACL column.

tables.title: Table 177 ACE Table Description
tables.table_md:
| Column Number | Column Name | IsUnique | Column Type |
|---|---|---|---|

| 0x01 | Name | Yes | name |
| 0x02 | CommonName | Yes | name |
